predictions.source_summary: The 'newer' flag comes from the constructor option 'opt.newer', which when true, prevents unpacking over files that are newer than those in the archive. The 'entry.mtime' is derived from archive metadata during parsing, and 'st.mtime' is the modification time of the existing file on disk.
predictions.sink_summary: If the condition is true, the function calls [SKIPNEWER] which skips unpacking the entry, preventing potential overwriting of newer files. This is a security-sensitive decision as it controls whether files can be overwritten based on timestamp comparisons.
predictions.guard_summary: The guard is the 'newer' flag set during initialization. It's effective in that when true, it prevents overwriting newer files, but it's not sufficient to prevent all potential issues since it only considers timestamps and doesn't validate other aspects of file integrity or authenticity.
predictions.risk_pattern: Timestamp-based file overwrite prevention where the decision is made based on comparing modification times between archive entries and existing files. If 'newer' flag is enabled, files in the archive that are older than existing files will be skipped during unpacking.
predictions.context_summary: This code is part of the [CHECKFS] method in the Unpack class. It determines whether to skip unpacking an entry based on timestamp comparison when the 'newer' flag is enabled. The decision affects whether a file will be overwritten during extraction.
